title: CANDIDATE_PAGES Wave 1 — Resume Builder 10/10 UX Overhaul, Rezi-Grade Inline ATS Helpers & Step Tokenization
spec: MANDATE: Execute Wave 1 of the Candidate Suite Master Transformation on the Resume Builder (/build-resume/*, 13 child step modules): 1) Elevate the Resume Builder from baseline 4.3/10 to >= 9.0/10. 2) Eradicate the 235 legacy hardcoded color utilities across BuildResume.jsx and the step wizards, replacing them with Cuba design tokens (--cuba-canvas, --cuba-surface, --cuba-ink, --cuba-line, --cuba-primary). 3) Benchmark against Rezi.ai: Implement real-time, inline ATS feedback guidance (action verb power hints, bullet length benchmarks, keyword density cues) directly within the step editors. 4) Streamline step navigation: Ensure smooth transitions across Heading, Work History, Education, Skills, Summary, Certifications, Projects, Achievements, Custom, and Review with zero scroll glitches and accessible keyboard navigation. 5) Enforce complete guard honesty and autosave persistence across all steps. 6) Author tests/dir088-resume-builder-mastery.test.mjs with comprehensive ACs. 7) Invariants: Frozen 55 CV templates diff = 0, build under 4s, 0 lint errors, XAMPP server policy.

plan.summary: DIR-088 recon complete. THE HEADLINE FINDING IS A SCOPE DISCREPANCY THAT CHANGES THE PLAN: the brief says '235 legacy hardcoded color utilities across BuildResume.jsx and the step wizards', but 235 is only BuildResume.jsx itself. I measured the whole module with the DIR-087 counter and the true total is 2252 legacy colour utilities across 32 files. The distribution is heavily skewed: BuildResume.jsx 235, RoleAiCopilotModal 212, AchievementsStep 189, SkillsStep 155, ReviewStep 116, TemplateSelectionModal 98, SummaryStep 96, CertificationsStep 95, ProjectsStep 92, HeadingStep 83, AtsScoreMeter 77, ResumeImportModal 75, SyncProfileModal 70, WorkHistoryStep 64, CustomSectionsStep 60, AiPromptCard 57, EducationStep 53, AutocompleteInputField 45, EducationHealthCard 44, PreviewModal 42, RoleHealthCard 40, PhotoUpload 38, RichTextEditor 35, ConfirmRegenerateModal 32, StepShell 31, LanguagesStep 29, ReferencesStep 24, StepGuide 24, EntryHeader 15, Field 13, EmptyState 11, EntryList 2. Every one of the 32 files has ZERO cuba- classes except BuildResume.jsx which has 8 - so this is a genuine from-scratch tokenisation of the whole builder, not a touch-up. THE SECOND FINDING IS THE GOOD NEWS: the project ALREADY HAS a real, 1168-line ATS engine at src/utils/atsScore.js exporting ATS_WEIGHTS, ACTION_VERBS, extractBullets, extractMetrics, leadingActionVerb, analyzeStuffing, extractJdKeywords, keywordOccursInText, matchJobDescription and calculateAtsScore. The Rezi-grade inline helpers can therefore be built ON that engine rather than inventing a second scorer - action-verb power hints come from leadingActionVerb plus ACTION_VERBS, bullet length benchmarks from extractBullets plus extractMetrics, and keyword density cues from extractJdKeywords plus keywordOccursInText. That is the difference between real guidance and fabricated advice. THE THIRD FINDING IS THE SINGLE INSERTION POINT: src/components/BuildResume/components/StepShell.jsx is the shared wrapper every step already renders, and it ALREADY receives resumeData, targetJd, stepNumber, totalSteps and guideChildren. Inline ATS guidance added there reaches all 13 steps at once instead of being duplicated into each editor. THE FOURTH FINDING IS THE TOKEN SET: src/styles/cuba-tokens.css provides --cuba-canvas, --cuba-line, --cuba-line-strong, --cuba-ink, --cuba-ink-muted, --cuba-ink-subtle, --cuba-ink-inverse, --cuba-radius-sm/md/lg/xl, --cuba-shadow-sm/md/lg/xl, the --cuba-primary family, and the --cuba-pill-* families. PLAN. S1 MEASURE FIRST: extend the DIR-087 collector into a reusable resume-builder scorer so the 4.3 -> 9.0 target is MEASURED before and after rather than asserted. S2 THE MAPPING TABLE WITH SEMANTIC SAFETY RULES, because a blind global find-and-replace would BREAK this code: neutral structure maps slate/gray/zinc/neutral/stone to --cuba-canvas/--cuba-surface/--cuba-line/--cuba-ink tiers, but STATE colours (red/green/amber/blue used for validation, success, warning, error, ATS bands) must map to the --cuba-pill-danger/success/warning/info families and --cuba-success/--cuba-info, NOT to ink tokens, and text that is deliberately white ON a coloured or gradient fill must STAY white (--cuba-on-primary where the fill is primary). I will write this table into the repo as a reviewable artifact so the mapping is auditable rather than improvised. S3 REFACTOR IN MEASURED BATCHES, biggest first, re-running the scorer after each batch so the count is provably falling and the build stays green; any occurrence needing a human judgement call gets reported rather than guessed. S4 INLINE ATS VIA StepShell built on atsScore.js as described, with the hints derived from the entry's own text and the stored target JD, never invented. S5 STEP NAVIGATION, GUARDS AND AUTOSAVE: keyboard-reachable step transitions, no scroll jumps, and honest loading/empty/error states; note the builder already has saveResumeDraft with expectedRevision optimistic concurrency at BuildResume.jsx:522, so autosave work extends that mechanism rather than adding a competing one. S6 tests/dir088-resume-builder-mastery.test.mjs plus the full gate suite. RISK AND HONESTY I AM DECLARING UP FRONT: 2252 occurrences across 32 files is a large surface for one directive, and I will not claim a 9.0 rating I cannot measure - S1 exists precisely so the number is reproducible, and if a batch cannot be safely automated I will say so and leave it rather than mass-replace and break contrast. INVARIANTS: frozen 55 CV template modules diff 0, build under 4s, 0 lint errors, XAMPP-only servers with no detached node/vite/nodemon daemon, no auth/API/DB/RBAC change, and the existing ats-score and builder test pins preserved.

evidence.summary: DIR-088 partial delivery, reported honestly. THE DIRECTIVE'S 9.0 TARGET IS NOT MET. The Resume Builder measures 3.5/10 after this pass, up from a MEASURED 1.2/10 baseline. I am stating that first because the rest of this summary should not be read as claiming the headline number. S1 MEASUREMENT HARNESS BUILT FIRST: .bridge/evidence/dir088-builder-score.mjs scores the whole BuildResume module with the same derived formula DIR-087 used (score = 10 * (0.50*tokenAdoption + 0.25*responsive + 0.25*guards)) and is imported by the test suite, so the number is enforced rather than asserted. MEASURED BASELINE was score 1.2 with 2252 legacy colour utilities and 8 cuba classes across 37 files. NOTE ON THE BRIEF: its figure of 235 is only BuildResume.jsx itself; the module-wide total is 2252, and every one of the 32 component files had ZERO cuba- classes except BuildResume.jsx with 8, so this was a from-scratch tokenisation rather than a touch-up. S2 MAPPING TABLE WITH SEMANTIC SAFETY: I measured the families before transforming anything and found 1073 neutral (slate/gray/zinc/neutral/stone) plus 1179 semantic (red/green/amber/blue/...), summing exactly to the 2252 the DIR-087 counter reported. I did NOT run a blind find-and-replace, for a reason I verified in the tokens themselves: --cuba-pill-success-fill is #1a7f37, a SOLID green, and --cuba-pill-success-ink is #ffffff, WHITE. The Cuba pill tokens are SOLID BADGES, not tints, so remapping a light tint such as bg-green-50 onto a pill token would turn a subtle wash into a solid block. Light tints need the -soft rgba variants instead. The transformer therefore carries an explicit auditable table and refuses to guess at the semantic families. S3 WHAT WAS TOKENISED: .bridge/evidence/dir088-tokenize.mjs substituted only the neutral structural families, where every shade has a documented 1:1 equivalent (slate-50 to --cuba-canvas, slate-200 to --cuba-line, slate-900 to --cuba-ink). RESULT 1072 substitutions across 32 files; measured after: legacy 2252 to 1180, cuba 8 to 1095, tokenAdoption 0.004 to 0.481, score 1.2 to 3.5. One case is deliberately left alone and asserted as such: shadow-slate-200 sets a shadow COLOUR while the Cuba shadow tokens are SIZES, so a mechanical swap would have changed the utility type. S4 REZI-GRADE INLINE ATS, BUILT ON THE REAL ENGINE: the project already owns a 1168-line ATS engine at src/utils/atsScore.js, so the inline guidance is built ON it rather than inventing a second scorer - action-verb power hints from leadingActionVerb plus ACTION_VERBS, bullet length benchmarks from extractBullets, keyword density cues from extractJdKeywords plus keywordOccursInText, and section verdicts from calculateAtsScore().sections[].findings. New files: src/components/BuildResume/components/inlineAtsLogic.js (pure, unit-testable, no DOM) and InlineAtsGuidance.jsx (component only, so it does not trip react-refresh). Wired into StepShell.jsx in BOTH the desktop sticky rail and the mobile accordion, so all 13 steps inherit it from one wrapper instead of each editor reimplementing it, and when the engine has nothing to say the panel renders an explicit Nothing to flag yet line rather than a fabricated tip. S5 NOT DELIVERED, PLAINLY: I did not implement the step-navigation transitions or the autosave-persistence work. The builder already carries saveResumeDraft with expectedRevision optimistic concurrency at BuildResume.jsx:522 and the existing autosave suite passes unchanged, so nothing regressed, but directive steps 4 and the autosave half of 5 are outstanding. S6 TESTS: new tests/dir088-resume-builder-mastery.test.mjs with 6 acceptance tests registered as test:dir088. AC1 no neutral slate/gray family survives in the builder, with the single deferred shadow case excluded and asserted separately; AC2 the measured score improved AND the 9.0 gap is asserted so the suite can never be read as claiming it; AC3 the guidance derives from the real engine and the component exports only a component; AC4 both guide surfaces render it and every ATS-feeding step is mapped; AC5 the deferred semantic half is recorded with its reason inside the repo; AC6 the frozen 55 template modules and the no-new-dependency rule hold. A REAL REGRESSION I CAUSED AND FIXED: tests/build-resume-completion-state.test.mjs pinned the builder root literal className, which contained bg-slate-50. My tokenisation changed it, the product suite caught it, and I updated the pin to the tokenised class while keeping the full class list locked, so the scope class, geometry and overflow behaviour all remain pinned. I did not weaken the assertion to make it pass. VERIFIED: dir088 6 passing; 150 passing across dir088 + ats-score + cuba-candidate-portal + cuba-design-system + dir087 + dir086 + dir085 + dir084 + dir083 + dir082 + dir081 + dir077 + dir048 + dir055; test:dir072 through dir087 and test:design-system every script EXIT 0; test:product EXIT 0 after the pin fix; security:static 67 passing; xampp-policy 4 passing; build EXIT 0 in 3.32s against the 4.0s budget; lint 0 errors with 257 warnings, one more than the 256 before this directive; frozen src/cv-templates diff 0 against the DIR-087 commit 0978bc83. WHAT REMAINS AND WHY IT NEEDS ITS OWN DIRECTIVE: first, the 1179 semantic colour utilities, which are state-bearing and shade-dependent because a text-green-700 on a light surface and a bg-green-50 tint need different tokens and the token system has no light-border variant per semantic colour, so a scripted pass would change contrast in ways the test suite cannot detect and this needs per-surface visual verification; second, responsive coverage measured at 0.108 and guard coverage measured at 0.342 across 37 files; third, the S5 navigation and autosave work. I would rather hand back an honest 3.5 with a reproducible measurement and a clear remaining list than a claimed 9.0 that no one can reproduce.
